system.description:
After a successful Strike you may make a Strange Check with CR equal to the struck enemy's CR. Heal 1 wound per Strange symbol rolled above that CR; Doom +1 per wound healed.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.64
system.summary: After a successful Strike you may make a Strange Check with CR equal to the struck enemy's CR. Heal 1 wound per Strange symbol rolled above that CR; Doom +1 per wound healed.

automation.label: After a successful Strike (CR = the struck enemy's CR)
automation.onSuccess: Heal 1 wound per Strange symbol above the enemy's CR; Doom +1 per wound healed.

automation.note: Optional, right after one of your Strikes hits; the Director sets the CR to the struck enemy's CR. Heal yourself 1 wound per Strange symbol above the CR and tick Doom +1 per wound healed, by hand (the amount depends on the margin).
